svg.title: 17/4. The intermediate dimension is three or four; the iid endpoint needs dimension one. In the admitted high-noise interval the exact one-step Pareto points are (d, k) = (3, 9) and (4, 3). Here k is the Choi rank of the channel retaining the classical symbol and final memory, equivalently its minimum initially pure Stinespring remainder dimension. At λ = .99 a different qutrit source has one-step cost fifteen but lower complete-history cost, with certified bounds 48 ≤Rmin 2 ≤50, λ† = 1− √︂ 71 −17 √
